This pvp hud will make your friends jealous:D

(Fps settings or guide:



![minecraft game is showing more then 300 fps ![It works better then sodium great for old computers! ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50c43dd5b36add67e363bdbfdce2419497b01f91.png)

*How to make sure that it works:

1. Click videosettings sodium, sodium extra should pop up.
 
2. When entering a server you should see a hud displaying the picture. And down in the hotbar a red cube shows a missing totem.

*Best settings for sodium and sodium extra (Best gameplay and better fps):

1. Graphics: Set to Fast. It prioritizes performance by reducing complex textures and lighting.
Render Distance: Set between 8 to 12 chunks. (Lower to 4-6 if you have a lower-end PC).

2. Simulation Distance: Set to 6 to 8 chunks.

3. Smooth Lighting: Set to Maximum.
The performance impact is low, but visually, it makes a massive difference.

4. Clouds: Set to Fast or Off.

5. Particles: Set to Decreased or Minimal

Sodium extra:

1. Animations: Turn off water, lava, and fire animations if you are hunting for extra FPS, or leave them on if you have a decent GPU.

2. Fog: Turn off Fog (under Render Settings) for clearer vision and a slight FPS boost.

3. Advanced/Extra: Toggle the built-in FPS display or Coordinates display on if you prefer to monitor performance while playing.
